name: Maxim Yurov
source:
When they turn their passion toward you, the cracks in their lifelong bond threaten to destroy them. Only with your help can wounds they left on one another heal. Can you survive the depth of their love, or will you dance into the abyss too?

[From [url=https://openlategames.itch.io/speakeasy]Itch.io[/url]]
